prompt.comment: Comment on {id} for the agent who will build it: reply to this message.
prompt.summary: {id} is done. What was done? Reply to this message: your words go into the thank-you e-mail to the pilot (language: {lang}). You will see the draft before anything is sent.
prompt.summaryNoEmail: {id} is done. What was done? Reply to this message to keep it with the idea (the pilot left no e-mail, so there is no thank-you e-mail; language: {lang}).
ok.summaryNoEmail: Saved what was done on {id}. No e-mail: the pilot left no address.
draft.head: Draft of the thank-you e-mail to {to} ({lang}, {id}). It goes only when you press Send:
draft.subject: Subject: {subject}
mail.queued: The e-mail to {to} ({id}) goes in {s} s.
mail.waiting: Gmail is not set up yet (GMAIL_USER and GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD in config.env on the server). The e-mail to {to} ({id}) is saved and waits; once Gmail is set up I will ask you whether to send it.
mail.noEmail: The pilot of {id} left no e-mail address (contact: {contact}). Answer them there; your answer is kept with the idea.
mail.ask: Gmail is set up now. This e-mail to {to} ({id}) has been waiting. Send it?
mail.cancelled: Cancelled: the e-mail to {to} ({id}) was not sent.
mail.unknown: The e-mail to {to} ({id}) may or may not have gone ({error}). Look in Gmail's Sent folder before you send it again.
mail.failedRetry: The e-mail to {to} ({id}) did not go ({error}). I will try again at {time}.
mail.failed: The e-mail to {to} ({id}) did not go ({error}).
mail.tooLate: Too late: it is being sent or has been sent.
mail.noDraft: No draft to send: it has already been sent or replaced.
mail.staleDraft: This draft was replaced by a newer one, so nothing was sent. The current draft is below.
note.created: Note {id} saved. Accept it and give it an urgency to put it in the work queue.
note.empty: Write the note after the command, for example: /note A pilot wants night scenes pilot@example.com #high #pl
queue.title: Work queue ({n}):
cmd.note: Write down a pilot's idea: text, e-mail, #urgency, #language
help:
ShramkoGSFPV ideas.

Every bug report and idea from the site comes here as a card.
- Reply to a card: your answer goes to the pilot by e-mail from your Gmail, {s} s later (Cancel stops it).
- The translation: your reply goes to the pilot in the language they wrote in. You see the translated e-mail first, with your original under it, and can send your own words instead.
- Accept, Reject, In progress, Done and the urgency buttons decide what happens to it. An idea enters the work queue once it is accepted and has an urgency.
- Comment: a note for the agent who will build it.
- Done: write what was done; you get the draft thank-you e-mail in the pilot's language, and it goes only when you press Send.

/note <text>: a pilot's idea told outside the form; add their e-mail, #urgent #high #normal #low and #en #es #pl #ru if you know them.
/queue: the work queue.
/help: this text.

I act only on GSFPV cards and these commands; anything else here (another site's lead, a reply to it) I leave alone.
mail.queuedTranslated: The e-mail to {to} ({id}) goes in {s} s. Your text was translated ({source} → {language}, the language the pilot wrote in). Check the translation below. Cancel stops the e-mail; "Send my original instead" sends your own words as you wrote them.
mail.language: NOT sent: the e-mail to {to} ({id}) is neither in English nor in {language}, the pilot's language, and it could not be translated ({why}). Write it again in English or in {language} (reply to the card), or press "Send as written" to send it anyway.
why.noKey: no translation key is set on the server
mail.originalChosen: Replaced: the e-mail to {to} ({id}) now carries your own words; see the new message below.
mail.noOriginal: Nothing to swap: this e-mail has no translation, or it is already sent or cancelled.
draft.translated: Translated ({source} → {language}, the language the pilot wrote in); the original is below.
